## DatabaseBulkOperationResult

Aggregate result of a bulk operation. The \`succeeded\` and \`failed\` lists together cover every requested row exactly once so the client can render a structured toast (e.g. "3 of 12 updated, 9 failed: cell invalid") without re-deriving counts.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field and return type | Arguments and description |
| --- | --- |
| `failed`<br>\[[DatabaseBulkRowOutcome](./objects.md#databasebulkrowoutcome)!\]! |  |
| `failureCount`<br>`Int`! |  |
| `succeeded`<br>\[`ID`!\]! |  |
| `successCount`<br>`Int`! |  |
| `total`<br>`Int`! |  |
| `transactionCommitted`<br>`Boolean`! |  |

## DatabaseBulkRowOutcome

Per-row diagnostic entry for a bulk operation. Either \`success\` is \`true\` (and \`errorCode\` / \`errorMessage\` are \`None\`) or \`success\` is \`false\` and the failure carries a structured \`MIX\_DATABASE\_\*\` code.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field and return type | Arguments and description |
| --- | --- |
| `errorCode`<br>`String` |  |
| `errorMessage`<br>`String` |  |
| `rowId`<br>`ID`! |  |
| `success`<br>`Boolean`! |  |

| `adoptCopilotBlob`<br>`String`! | `copilotBlobKey`: `String`!<br>`workspaceId`: `String`!<br><br>Adopt a copilot-generated blob into the workspace blob store. Copilot blobs are stored ephemerally under a \`{user\_id}/{workspace\_id}/{filename}\` key and are not tracked in the \`blobs\` DB table — they are subject to nightly cleanup once the session that produced them is deleted. This mutation copies the bytes into the workspace blob store (under \`{workspace\_id}/{new\_key}\`) and creates a \`blobs\` DB record so the blob is permanent and accessible via the regular blob API. \`copilot\_blob\_key\` must be a path of the form \`{user\_id}/{workspace\_id}/{filename}\` where \`user\_id\` matches the authenticated caller. Returns the new workspace-scoped blob key on success. |

## PdfExportJobType

One PDF export job. Returned by \`exportPdf\` (sync or async path) and \`pdfExportJob\` (poll). State machine: \`queued → running → done&#124;failed\`. Sync renders skip \`queued\`/\`running\` and land directly in \`done\` (or fail with a GraphQL error before any row is returned).

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field and return type | Arguments and description |
| --- | --- |
| `createdAt`<br>[DateTime](./scalars.md#datetime)! |  |
| `docId`<br>`String`! |  |
| `downloadUrl`<br>`String` | Present only when \`status == done\` and \`output\_blob\_id\` is set. The path is workspace-scoped: a leaked \`id\` alone is not enough to fetch the file (the REST handler re-checks workspace Read permission). |
| `errorClass`<br>`String` | Stable machine-readable failure category, set when \`status == failed\`. Possible values: \`TooLarge\`, \`Timeout\`, \`RenderError\`, \`DecodeError\`, \`AssetError\`, \`TemplateError\`, \`StorageError\`, \`EnqueueError\`, \`Stalled\`. Pin user-facing translations on this field, never on \`error\_detail\`. |
| `errorDetail`<br>`String` | Free-form failure message suitable for log lines. May contain renderer/storage-backend text and is \*\*not\*\* intended for end-user display. |
| `expiresAt`<br>[DateTime](./scalars.md#datetime) | Set when the job transitions to \`done\`. The download URL stops working after this timestamp; the nightly cleanup sweep purges the row and the underlying blob shortly after. |
| `id`<br>`String`! |  |
| `pageCount`<br>`Int` | Number of pages in the rendered PDF. Populated when \`status == done\`; \`None\` while queued/running and on failed renders. |
| `startedAt`<br>[DateTime](./scalars.md#datetime) | Set when the worker (or sync path) begins rendering. \`None\` while the job is still \`queued\`. Clients can use \`(now - started\_at)\` to estimate how long the active render has been running. |
| `status`<br>[PdfExportJobStatus](./enums.md#pdfexportjobstatus)! |  |
| `unmappedFontFamilies`<br>\[`String`!\]! | Theme font families the renderer could not match in the FontBook. This should stay empty in production because the API resolves every effective role to a pinned TTF/OTF/VF asset before dispatch. A non-empty value is therefore diagnostic evidence that the server-side Theme DB gate was bypassed or an asset vanished after enqueue. |
| `workspaceId`<br>`String`! |  |

## PdfTemplatePublic

Public, workspace-facing projection of a PDF template. Compared to the internal \[\`PdfTemplate\`\] this: - Drops \`created\_by\`, \`created\_at\`, \`deleted\_at\` (admin metadata). - Carries the \`is\_default\` flag from the workspace's assignment row so the export picker can pre-select it. - Surfaces \`manifest.capabilities\` as a JSON sub-object so the picker can render capability inputs (toggle / enum / color / array&lt;string&gt;) without an extra round-trip. - Surfaces \`manifest.inputs\_schema\` so the picker can prefill required \`typed\_inputs\` before the mutation hits the server-side validator.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field and return type | Arguments and description |
| --- | --- |
| `capabilities`<br>[JSON](./scalars.md#json)! | \`manifest.capabilities\` slice as JSON. Empty object if the manifest has no capabilities block (defensive — schema validation rejects this at upload time, but we don't trust DB-state invariants here). |
| `id`<br>`ID`! |  |
| `inputsSchema`<br>[JSON](./scalars.md#json)! | \`manifest.inputs\_schema\` slice as JSON. Empty object if the manifest does not constrain typed inputs. |
| `isDefault`<br>`Boolean`! | Whether this template is the workspace's default selection in the export picker. |
| `name`<br>`String`! |  |
| `schemaVersion`<br>`String`! |  |
| `slug`<br>`String`! |  |
| `version`<br>`String`! |  |

| `enabled`<br>`Boolean`! | Master switch: when false, Git Sync UI is hidden from all users. |
| `maxMirrorStorageMb`<br>`Int`! | Maximum total disk space (MB) for git mirror repositories (global setting). |
| `sshHostKeyPolicy`<br>`String`! | SSH host-key verification policy used by server-side Git transports. |
| `webhookAllowed`<br>`Boolean`! | Whether webhook-triggered sync is available. |

## WorkspaceQuotaDetailsType

Full quota state for a single workspace — returned by \`adminWorkspaceQuotaDetails\`. Exposes the raw values at every level of the priority hierarchy alongside the resolved effective quota and current usage, so the admin inspector can display both the active source and all configured overrides at a glance.

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
| Field and return type | Arguments and description |
| --- | --- |
| `configDefaultMb`<br>`Int`! | Config-level default in megabytes (server config). 0 = unlimited at config level. |
| `effectiveBytes`<br>`Int`! | Resolved effective quota in bytes. 0 = unlimited. |
| `source`<br>[WorkspaceQuotaSource](./enums.md#workspacequotasource)! | Which level of the hierarchy determined the effective quota. |
| `usedBytes`<br>`Int`! | Current total storage usage in bytes (snapshot + blob). |
| `workspaceOverrideBytes`<br>`Int` | Workspace-level storage override in bytes. \`null\` = not set. |
